description: This Java class provides utility methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation. It includes functions to generate timestamps, format dates in various patterns, add days to the current date, and process date parameters from HTTP requests.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling date formatting and processing in the sales manager web application.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string in the format 'yyyyMMddHHmmSS'.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using the default date format.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a Date object to extract the year as a string.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a long date string with day name, date, month, year, time, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a date string with pattern 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getDate (String)
methods.description: Parses a date string in the default format into a Date object.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object that is a specified number of days from today.

methods.name: getDate()
methods.description: Returns the current date and time.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HttpServletRequest and sets internal date fields accordingly.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date set by processPostedDates.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date set by processPostedDates.
